title: China-to-Indonesia Refrigerator Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: Energy labeling and minimum energy performance for household refrigerators
rows.target_requirement: Indonesia requires household refrigerators imported for sale to carry an ESDM energy label with compliant efficiency class and minimum-energy-performance controls before market placement, with label language and declaration prepared for the Indonesian market. Exporter sales materials and shipping labels should match the approved model and class used for customs and post-entry control.
target_standards: Peraturan Menteri ESDM on household electrical appliance energy labelling and import-side verification framework
Peraturan Menteri ESDM on the star-rating (SKEM) labelling mechanism
rows.china_equivalent: China generally relies on domestic appliance efficiency labeling systems and family-specific data under GB-based standards for product sales inside China. Chinese labels are not automatically accepted in Indonesian customs and shelf entry checks when model class, unit size class, and market declaration differ from the declared Indonesia file.
china_standards: China energy-labeling and efficiency disclosure framework for household appliances
GB 12021 series references for refrigerator energy performance limits
rows.gap: Exporters must align model-level energy class, net volume brackets, voltage assumptions, and energy declaration language to the Indonesia submission file. Reusing China-only labels or translated labels without Indonesian model approval often causes desk review delays at port intake.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory for refrigerators within scope of ESDM energy-labelling requirements and market entry controls.
mandatory_status.cn: China labels support domestic market sales but do not replace Indonesian energy-label submission requirements.

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Validate final SKEM star class and label artwork against the exact import model, and keep copies in the export file. Do not assume Chinese domestic labels are accepted as Indonesian energy evidence.

rows.requirement: ESDM energy label permission and model registration
rows.target_requirement: The Indonesia market requires refrigerators to have valid energy label permission tied to the submitted model registration data. The label is treated as a condition of market readiness and may block customs release and domestic sale if missing or inconsistent with approved class and declared capacity class.
target_standards: Kementerian ESDM appliance energy label policy and enforcement guidance
rows.china_equivalent: China domestic label permission uses China-specific templates and declaration channels and is generally assessed against domestic sales channels rather than Indonesia market files.
china_standards: China residential appliance energy label rules
GB energy efficiency disclosure standards for domestic appliance sales
rows.gap: Exporters can reuse test data in principle but must create an Indonesia-facing label package with approved wording, local language format, and model-specific class mapping before shipment or warehousing.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory when the refrigerator product family is required to carry label under ESDM labeling controls.
mandatory_status.cn: China domestic labeling remains separate and does not replace Indonesia permission conditions.

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Prepare a model-specific energy-label package once, in the Indonesian language format required by local authorities, and reconcile class boundaries with the exact sold variant.

rows.requirement: Minimum energy performance thresholds (MEPS) for refrigerators
rows.target_requirement: Indonesia applies minimum-efficiency expectations for listed household appliances, and non-compliant units can be stopped from customs release or distributor stocking where national controls are applied at inspection points or through ministry coordination.
target_standards: ESDM energy efficiency and appliance-label framework under national energy conservation governance
Ministry-level implementing rules for minimum energy performance levels in household appliances
rows.china_equivalent: China market access can also rely on domestic performance classes and standards, but equivalence depends on class mappings and declared capacities. A China MEPS result does not automatically satisfy Indonesian minimum class thresholds.
china_standards: China appliance efficiency class framework for domestic market
GB test and class basis for Chinese refrigeration products
rows.gap: Map each Indonesian declared capacity segment and operating variant to the imported configuration before filing; if only a China class is available, obtain Indonesia-facing mapping evidence or request regulator clarification.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where national inspection or distribution readiness requires MEPS-level compliance for the model category.
mandatory_status.cn: China internal MEPS documentation is separate and does not replace Indonesia minimum-performance filing requirements.

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Reconfirm MEPS compliance using Indonesian declared categories and do not rely on domestic Chinese classing for final clearance decisions.

rows.requirement: SNI route and importer registration via SPPT-SNI and BSN/LSPRO
rows.target_requirement: Refrigerator importers must satisfy mandatory Indonesian SNI certification pathways. The process is controlled by BSN and Ministry of Industry structures, using accredited LSPro bodies for product testing and issuing SPPT-SNI documents, then affixing the SNI mark under approved conditions.
target_standards: BSN SNI certification administration framework for imported household electrical appliances
Kementerian Perindustrian implementation requirements for SNI market access
Regulatory expectation for SPPT-SNI issuance through accredited LSPro
rows.china_equivalent: China uses domestic CCC and related conformity systems for market launch. While testing evidence from China may aid technical review, it is not automatically treated as an Indonesian SPPT-SNI pathway.
china_standards: China CCC conformity-assessment and import model controls
GB safety and performance document framework for domestic product launch
rows.gap: Exporters often submit CCC-style files but still need Indonesian scope review, local approval identifiers, and updated model marking approvals. Misalignment is common when labels, importer name, and certificate numbers do not match the SNI filing copy.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory for targeted refrigerator imports where SNI is required by market-access scope and ministry rules.
mandatory_status.cn: China CCC testing and marks are domestic compliance artifacts and do not remove Indonesia SNI workflow obligations.

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Obtain SPPT-SNI documents before physical shipment planning and ensure certificate numbers, model names, and mark placements exactly mirror the Indonesian approval record.

rows.requirement: Importer of record, API-U and NIB responsibilities, and Indonesia port entry records
rows.target_requirement: Import operations require an in-country importer role with clear API-U and NIB alignment for customs and ministry coordination. Typical logistics channels include Tanjung Priok (Jakarta) and Tanjung Perak (Surabaya), and shipment documents should match the approved importer identity and product file.
target_standards: Ministry of Industry and trade-linked importer registration requirements (API-U)
OSS/NIB registration requirement for entities participating in Indonesian import activity
Port-level customs process practices for refrigerated appliances
rows.china_equivalent: China domestic export flows center on Chinese customs declarations and domestic trading entities. The importer-of-record architecture is not equivalent to Chinese exporter-side customs roles when the destination is Indonesia.
china_standards: Chinese customs declaration and trade documentation system for exports
China-side quality and trade control channels
rows.gap: Common blockers are missing Indonesian importer identifiers, absent API-U/NIB evidence, or shipment files listing a different consignee than the market-access record. Keep importer, consignee, and model hierarchy synchronized before port filing at Tanjung Priok or Tanjung Perak.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory for clearing refrigerators into Indonesia where customs and ministry coordination requires importer-level registration and filing details.
mandatory_status.cn: China customs export paperwork does not replace Indonesia in-country importer registration and API-U/NIB controls.

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Confirm importer credentials and consignee identity in the same document set used for SNI filings, and mirror that set against shipment declarations by port before export completion.

rows.requirement: Refrigerant type expectations for imported refrigerators and safety communication
rows.target_requirement: Product files for Indonesian placement commonly reference low-GWP hydrocarbon practice in current policy context, with R-600a commonly treated as the accepted benchmark for many domestic-cold products. Refrigerant declaration and service information should be consistent with Indonesian compliance filing.
target_standards: Ministry of Environment and Forestry transition and fluorinated gas control coordination as applied to imported refrigerants
ESDM appliance safety and environmental context for volatile refrigerant handling
rows.china_equivalent: China exports often use R-600a or related products under Chinese environmental and refrigerant reporting practices. However, the Indonesia import control packet uses different administrative wording and acceptance checks.
china_standards: China refrigerant management and ODS transition practice for domestic product lines
GB environmental and product declaration practice for compressors and household units
rows.gap: The exporter should submit Indonesia-facing refrigerant documentation aligned to model, charge weight, and service safety language. Unmapped chemical disclosure tables or mixed-specification labels are typical causes of follow-up questions at market-access review.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where Indonesian market files and environmental controls request refrigerant declaration for importer-side and ministry screening.
mandatory_status.cn: China domestic refrigerant notation is useful for technical reference but not a stand-alone replacement for Indonesia refrigerant declaration requirements.

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Keep a single authoritative refrigerant declaration per model in Indonesian language or required bilingual format, and include R-600a handling, leak response, and charge limits as declared for the imported configuration.

rows.requirement: Electrical safety and product standard baseline for refrigerators
rows.target_requirement: Indonesia references SNI-aligned safety expectations equivalent to IEC 60335-2-24 for refrigerators and requires proper SNI marking controls. In practice, the local check also assumes operating assumptions aligned to 230 V, 50 Hz appliances, and model declarations that match imported variants.
target_standards: SNI standard framework for refrigerator electrical safety and product marking
IEC 60335-2-24 alignment through adopted SNI references
Grid compatibility and installation assumptions in Indonesian technical review
rows.china_equivalent: China commonly documents electrical safety under GB 4706.13 and GB 4706.1 with CCC marking. These tests are useful for engineering comparison but do not automatically satisfy Indonesia's SNI plus marking regime.
china_standards: China CCC safety certification path for electrical appliances
GB 4706.1 and GB 4706.13 electrical safety framework
rows.gap: Critical export gaps are plug and supply assumptions, protection settings, warning symbols, and local language manuals. The voltage mismatch risk (Chinese 220/380 V design families versus Indonesian 230 V single-phase use in this lane) is common when documents are reused without a mode mapping.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory for in-scope imported refrigerators under safety and market-entry controls.
mandatory_status.cn: CCC safety evidence remains domestic and does not replace Indonesia-specific SNI-mark review and filing.

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Rebuild safety declarations for the exact Indonesian 230V deployment variant. Confirm plug, warning labels, and user manuals against the final SNI submission package before shipment.
